REMEDIATION (2026-09-30): Zainab's security review (evidence/BIO-INT-001/codex/SECURITY-REVIEW-ZAINAB.md) FAILed builder commit ff0aa17 High BIO-INT-001-F01 - InMemoryMfaChallengeProvider's public ExpectedCodeFor derived the MFA code as a fixed SHA-256 prefix of the challenge id, which every legitimate mfa_required response hands the caller, so any caller could compute the code themselves and bypass MFA. Fixed in commit 03cba7b: the code is now RandomNumberGenerator-generated, independent of the challenge id, and returned only to the in-process caller of IssueChallengeAsync via an internal-only AuthenticationOutcome.DemoOnlyMfaCode field never reachable through any HTTP response. Disclosed consequence: a real MFA-required sign-in cannot complete through the live endpoints until a real out-of-band transport adapter is plugged in behind IMfaChallengeProvider - a limitation, not a regression. Regression tests added at both the unit layer (An_attacker_who_knows_only_the_challenge_id_cannot_derive_the_code) and the real HTTP layer (An_attacker_with_only_the_http_visible_challenge_id_cannot_verify_mfa), the latter being the exact test Zainab's review asked for.
